citation: Wouda MF, et al. Spinal Cord Ser Cases 2023;9:32
protocol: Two maximal arm-cranking tests then three 4-min high-intensity arm-cranking bouts (85-95% of peak HR) with load in watts; HR, lactate and VO2 in pre-test, training bouts and maximal effort (read the able-bodied control column)
population: 6 able-bodied controls, 51.2 +/- 13.5 y, matched to 6 people with spinal cord injury (excluded)
note: Only the control group is healthy; arm crank is a small-muscle-mass exercise; SD given in brackets.
